metadata.policy: Missing inventory locales are provisional UI catalogs seeded from the English source catalog. Existing authored catalogs are preserved and are not marked provisional. Before authoring a listed provisional locale, remove it from provisionalLocales and run the generator without --refresh-provisional to promote its ownership; --refresh-provisional overwrites every locale that remains listed.

sourceExtensions.notes: Translated by the assistant (Claude in-session, parallel sub-agents reusing each locale's existing catalog terminology); not produced by scripts/translate-ui-catalogs.mjs and no paid translation API was used. DownloadModal.termsAgreement replaces the termsAgreementPrefix + termsOfUse + termsAgreementSuffix concatenation with one ICU rich-text sentence (<link> wraps the Terms of Use phrase) so verb-final languages keep their verb; where the old fragments already formed a correct sentence it reuses them. DownloadModal.termsOfUse is now only the Terms dialog heading, so locales whose value had been inflected for the old sentence were reset to the standalone heading form (listed in revisedMessagePaths). ShareModal.opensInNewTab is the share-button accessible name '{label} (opens in a new tab)'. Bridge-language catalogs (dyo, sav, srr, tnr in Wolof; mfv in Guinea-Bissau Kriol; snf in French; usp, xin in Spanish) follow that catalog's existing language. crk and mey-Latn remain explicit English fallbacks. Native-speaker review recommended, especially for the locales listed in reviewNotes.
